text: こんばんの　おかずは　ようい　しなくて　いいぞ！

structure.jp: こんばんの　おかずは
ようい　しなくて　いいぞ！
structure.en: you don't need to prepare them!

patterns.name: 〜なくていい
patterns.explanation: なくていい after a verb means 'it's fine not to do it', so 'you don't have to'. しなくて　いい = 'you don't have to do it'.

patterns.name: 〜ぞ
patterns.explanation: ぞ at the end is a strong, manly way of announcing something. いいぞ = 'it's fine, I tell you'.
